mapper.select: select e.escrow_id, e.escrow_no, e.order_id, e.amount, e.paid_at, e.pay_channel, e.status, e.release_time, e.release_reason, e.refund_amount, e.refunded_at, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.remark, o.order_no, w.title as work_title, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, ub.nick_name as buyer_name, us.nick_name as seller_name from sys_escrow e left join sys_order o on e.order_id = o.order_id left join sys_work w on o.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_user ub on o.buyer_id = ub.user_id left join sys_user us on o.seller_id = us.user_id where e.escrow_id = #{escrowId}

select e.escrow_id, e.escrow_no, e.order_id, e.amount, e.paid_at, e.pay_channel, e.status, e.release_time, e.release_reason, e.refund_amount, e.refunded_at, e.created_at, e.updated_at from sys_escrow e where e.order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
